comments.text: Okay, so perhaps they do lay it on a bit thick with that whole "most dangerous" element, though the place is probably more likely to do you in than its people if you're dumb or disrespect it, but I have to at least give them props for 1) Showing it as a _colourful_ place (which Hollywood hardly ever does!) and 2) The most accurate pronunciation of the name Björk I've heard from a nonnative speaker (rhymes with Work, _not_ Dork!!) 😎
